quotations.old_english: Hwæðer ðú nú ongite hwider þiós sprǽce wille?
quotations.latin: jamne igitur vides, quid haec omnia, quae diximus, consequatur

quotations.old_english: Apollonius hyre árehte ealle his gelymp, and æt þáre sprǽcan ende him feóllon teáras of ðám eágum

source_text: sprǽce, an; f. A talk, discourse :-- Hwæðer ðú nú ongite hwider þiós sprǽce wille? jamne igitur vides, quid haec omnia, quae diximus, consequatur, Bt. 40, 1; F. 234, 32. Apollonius hyre árehte ealle his gelymp, and æt þáre sprǽcan ende him feóllon teáras of ðám eágum, Ap. Th. 15, 26.
